notes.title: 1.3 - I'm better, I'm better!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27084283/11bf3aaf3bbeb3b2c56927fa4b01e047c3c14803.gif[/img]

[h1]Today BasementVR just became more social. [/h1]

We were thinking a lot about how do you use the app and came out with this idea. Thanks for the feedback and Steam recommendations! 

[b]We present to you: The Common Hall.[/b]

It is a special place where everybody can hang out and create using our tools. Everything you do will disappear after one hour.
What’s more: you will be able to see top rooms, recent rooms you entered and our selected rooms.

Don’t wait and jump in to BasementVR to create some more awesome stuff and check if it was your room that was featured!

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Featured most popular rooms in the city
notes.content:
Hi guys !
Thank you for your support in our development - we're really glad that you actively helping us with bug tracking, and coming up with ideas how to improve our product.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1][list][*]Most popular rooms are now much higher so they're easier to spot.
    [*]Onboarding system is working much smoother right now
    [*]You can login with your email address - soon you will receive your online address to your room to share it with friends more easily.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27084283/16637adcc2c325a928b707c2015929531e94ac72.jpg[/img]
